summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the 3 next-action items on tenant-sound-clinic-blr: (1) 500 fix on /ha/serial-items + /ha/amc/contracts + /ha/fittings via safe_deserialize_rows, (2) generic accessory preset seeder + silicone_dome preset, (3) accessory auto-decrement on invoice paid transition. 18/18 pytest cases in test_accessories_preset_autodec.py pass covering: legacy 500 regression (4 endpoints), preset catalogue shape + auth gate (2), preset-seed happy path + idempotency + RIC back-compat + role gate on audiologist/front_desk + unknown preset 400 (6), and auto-decrement happy path + zero-payment idempotency + partial→paid transition + non-accessory no side effect + shortfall floor-to-zero + ambiguous brand+model graceful skip (6). Playwright e2e as owner@thesoundclinic.in confirms /ha/accessories renders BOTH quick-add buttons with correct labels ('⚡ Quick-add Domes (S·M·L·Power)' and '⚡ Quick-add RIC Receivers'), Domes modal opens with S/M/L/Power banner + 'Create + Seed 4 sizes' button, save creates the SKU, second click with same brand is idempotent (still 1 row in catalogue), and RIC modal opens with 'Create + Seed 9 variants' button. Regression sweep over 9 HA sub-tabs — all return 200 with no error banners.
action_items: (nice-to-have) The Escape keypress does not close the PresetSeedModal — only the Cancel button + backdrop click work. Not blocking, but adds accessibility polish. Modal keyboard-close pattern could be added to ModalShell.

(nice-to-have) Frontend console had 2 unrelated 500s during the initial dashboard load (unrelated to this feature — not the 3 endpoints fixed here, since those now return 200). Worth an unrelated follow-up hunt.

(nice-to-have) The InvoiceLine.accessory_stock_decremented + accessory_product_id are internal plumbing fields but they surface on the /billing/invoices/{id} response payload. Consider hiding them from the public API surface once the UI accessory-picker plumbing is done, or documenting them.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/accessory_stock.py::_find_stock_row falls back to variant=None when the caller didn't pass a variant — but for variant-bearing products (like silicone_dome) the seeded rows all have concrete variants, so a None-variant query will never match and the code silently no-ops (skipped_no_row +=1). Consider warning louder OR falling back to 'first row with qty>=needed' when the product has variant_labels. Currently OK because the frontend accessory picker will set accessory_variant explicitly, but the graceful-skip behaviour is easy to miss.

utils/accessory_stock.py resolves the branch from the payment actor's branch_id. Multi-branch clinics where the accessory was invoiced from Branch A but the actor is stationed at Branch B will silently miss the stock row — could log an informational note in the future.

AccessoriesPage.jsx is now 1057 lines (grew from 1030). Still exceeds the 700-line guideline; splitting CatalogueTab / BatchStockTab / SerialisedTab / modals into separate files remains a good cleanup.

utils/serde.py::safe_deserialize_rows swallows Pydantic errors row-by-row — great for graceful degradation, but if the same row consistently fails, the log stream will pile up on every list request. Consider caching a 'known-bad-row-id' set per process to log once.

billing.py::_compute_line uses getattr(...) fallbacks for accessory_product_id/accessory_variant — the new InvoiceLineCreate has these declared, so getattr is defensive but slightly redundant. Direct attribute access would be cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all preset UI + idempotency + regression checks pass)
